_why: Cost guardrails G·2 (docs/plans/2026-11-11-guardrails-infra-a2.md). The source of truth for the frata project's Vercel Firewall; entered by hand in the dashboard (2026-11-11: the REST API answers 404 "config not found" for this project even after Bot Protection and a custom rule were published, so it cannot be applied or read back by API). Bypass rules run before the managed rulesets: Shiprocket, Mux and WhatsApp are not Vercel-verified bots (frata-integrations § Vercel platform, 2026-11-11). Bot Protection and AI Bots start in LOG; challenge only after a day of logs shows no real shopper, preview or webhook caught. Previous config before 2026-11-11: none (GET config/active answered 404).

rules.name: Bypass webhooks and crons
rules.description: Providers that aren't verified bots (Shiprocket, Mux) must always reach /api/webhooks; Vercel Cron reaches /api/cron. Each route checks its own signature or cron secret.

rules.name: Bypass link previews (WhatsApp, Telegram)
rules.description: Link previews of shops shared on WhatsApp and Telegram (unverified bots). The dashboard offers no regex for User Agent, so two 'contains' conditions joined by OR. A user agent can be faked; this skips bot rules only, not DDoS mitigation.
